title: Quick Pro XR:ONE launch display photos
notes: Launch-event photos of the Quick Pro XR:ONE frameset in a lime-to-white fade. The post says the gravel frame weighs about the same as the ER:ONE, is offered in XS to XXL and has many bolt mounts; these are not treated as measured values.

capture.scope: Archived public post; the selected photos were reviewed from the original files, which remain outside Git.
